en.summary: This commit fixes per-warp scoreboard issue bookkeeping so each warp sees issue-fire and issue-control metadata only when its own scalar or vector issue output actually fires.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly identifies a scoreboard if_fire bug.
The patch changes per-warp DUT issue bookkeeping in pipe.scala.
The new logic matches issue events by warp ID across both out_x and out_v instead of relying on a single hard-coded path.
evidence: scoreb(i).if_ctrl changes from a hardwired ibuffer2issue.io.out_x.bits assignment to a warp-matched Mux between out_x and out_v.
scoreb(i).if_fire changes from always false inside the loop to a per-warp predicate that checks both out_x.fire and out_v.fire against i.
The old ad hoc assignments to scoreb(out_x.wid) and scoreb(out_v.wid) are removed after the loop.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A per-context scoreboard must consume issue events as matched updates: the fire bit and control bundle for context N should come only from an issue output that actually fired for context N. If the design instead defaults every scoreboard bank to one issue port, or fails to compare the issued context ID before updating state, the wrong warp or thread group appears to have issued an instruction while the real issuer remains blocked.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple issue outputs exist and only one of them fires, or scalar and vector issue outputs fire for different contexts in the same window.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Update scoreboard issue-fire and issue-control from a shared issue port without checking that the scoreboard bank matches the issued context ID.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: broadcast shared issue event instead of per-context matched event
portability_notes: Apply this to designs with one scoreboard entry per warp, wavefront, thread group, or similar scheduling context.
The bug can be recreated by removing the equality check between scoreboard index and the ID on the issue output.
If the design has only one issue port, inject the same bug by feeding the scoreboard the wrong control bundle for the firing context.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that derives per-context scoreboard set or clear events from issue-stage fire signals.
Replace the per-context compare-and-select logic with a direct assignment from one issue output, or force one port to be ignored for scoreboard updates.
Make both the fire bit and the accompanying control record come from the wrong source so the bookkeeping remains self-consistent but targets the wrong context.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: scoreb(i).if_fire and scoreb(i).if_ctrl generation in the per-warp issue bookkeeping loop
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix replaces a hardwired out_x control assignment and always-false per-warp if_fire default with warp-matched logic that selects between ibuffer2issue out_x and out_v only when that warp actually fires.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In commit d47f2998, scoreb(i).if_ctrl becomes a warp-qualified Mux and scoreb(i).if_fire becomes a warp-qualified OR of out_x.fire and out_v.fire.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The wrong warp receives issue bookkeeping updates, producing false register reservations, missed reservations, or scoreboard stalls that appear only when dual issue is active.
evidence_for_injection: scoreboard.scala sets register and barrier state from if_fire and if_ctrl inputs.
Before the fix, the per-warp loop forced if_fire low and defaulted if_ctrl to out_x for every warp.
The fix specifically adds warp-ID matching across both issue outputs.
notes: This is a localized scoreboard bookkeeping bug; no execution datapath mutation is required for reinjection.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了按 warp 维护的 scoreboard 发射记账错误，使每个 warp 只有在自己的标量或向量发射口真正 fire 时才看到对应的 if_fire 和 if_ctrl。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出这是 scoreboard 的 if_fire 错误。
补丁修改的是 pipe.scala 中按 warp 进行的 DUT 发射记账逻辑。
新的逻辑会在 out_x 与 out_v 两个端口上按 warp ID 匹配发射事件，而不是依赖单一路径的硬编码。
evidence: scoreb(i).if_ctrl 从硬编码的 ibuffer2issue.io.out_x.bits 改成了按 warp 匹配的 out_x/out_v 二选一。
scoreb(i).if_fire 从循环中的恒 false 改成了检查 out_x.fire 与 out_v.fire 是否命中当前 warp 的谓词。
循环后面对 scoreb(out_x.wid) 和 scoreb(out_v.wid) 的临时赋值被删除。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 按上下文维护的 scoreboard 必须以“匹配更新”的方式消费发射事件：上下文 N 的 fire 位和控制信息只能来自真正为上下文 N 发射的那个 issue 输出。如果设计把所有 scoreboard bank 默认接到某一个 issue 端口，或者在更新前没有比较发射端口上的上下文 ID，那么错误的 warp 或线程组就会被当成已发射，而真正发射的那个上下文却保持阻塞。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 存在多个 issue 输出，且某一时刻只有其中一个 fire，或者标量和向量发射口分别为不同上下文发射。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在不检查 scoreboard bank 是否匹配发射上下文 ID 的情况下，用共享的某个 issue 端口去更新 scoreboard 的 if_fire 和 if_ctrl。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: broadcast shared issue event instead of per-context matched event
portability_notes: 适用于每个 warp、wavefront、线程组等都有独立 scoreboard 项的设计。
复现该 bug 的直接方法就是删除 scoreboard 索引与 issue 输出上下文 ID 之间的比较。
如果目标设计只有一个 issue 端口，也可以通过给 firing context 送入错误的控制 bundle 来注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到由 issue 级 fire 信号生成各上下文 scoreboard set/clear 事件的逻辑。
把原本按上下文比较并选择的逻辑改成直接取某一个 issue 输出，或者让 scoreboard 更新忽略某个 issue 端口。
让 fire 位和对应控制信息都来自错误来源，使记账内部保持自洽但目标上下文错误。
不要改动执行流水线本身。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 按 warp 发射记账循环中的 scoreb(i).if_fire 与 scoreb(i).if_ctrl 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把原先硬编码的 out_x 控制信息与恒 false 的 per-warp if_fire 改成了只有对应 warp 真正发射时，才在 ibuffer2issue 的 out_x 与 out_v 之间进行按 warp 选择。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在提交 d47f2998 中，scoreb(i).if_ctrl 变成了带 warp 条件的 Mux，scoreb(i).if_fire 也变成了对 out_x.fire 和 out_v.fire 的按 warp 条件 OR。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 错误的 warp 会收到发射记账更新，导致寄存器保留状态错误、保留缺失，或只在 dual-issue 启用时出现的 scoreboard 停顿。
evidence_for_injection: scoreboard.scala 会使用 if_fire 与 if_ctrl 去设置寄存器和 barrier 状态。
修复前，per-warp 循环把 if_fire 置为低，并把每个 warp 的 if_ctrl 默认接到 out_x。
修复的核心就是在两个发射输出上都加入 warp-ID 匹配。
notes: 这是局部的 scoreboard 记账错误；重新注入时不需要改动执行数据通路。
